description: Key US equity tax dates. stock_grant_date: the 83(b) election deadline, 30 days after restricted stock is transferred (rolled to the next business day when the 30th day is a weekend or legal holiday). qsbs_acquired_date: the Section 1202 holding-period milestones (50%, 75% and 100% exclusion at 3, 4 and 5 years for stock acquired after July 4, 2025; 5 years before). Give either or both. Use qsbs for the dollar exclusion on a sale. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/qsbs-calculator

as_of_date.description: Count days from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC).

qsbs_acquired_date.description: Date the stock was acquired (YYYY-MM-DD), for QSBS holding-period dates.

stock_grant_date.description: Date the restricted stock was transferred or granted (YYYY-MM-DD), for the 83(b) deadline.
